sloka: अर्घ्यमादाय रुचिरं जाह्नवीतीरमागमत् ।ददर्श राघवस्येष्टां सीतां पत्नीमनाथवत् ।। ७.४९.९ ।।
transliteration: arghyamādāya ruciraṁ jāhnavītīramāgamat ।dadarśa rāghavasyeṣṭāṁ sītāṁ patnīmanāthavat ।। 7.49.9 ।।

translations.english: Having taken a beautiful offering, Valmiki arrived at the bank of the Ganga and there saw Sita, Rama's beloved wife, appearing helpless and unprotected.
